result_text:
`all_files.zip` now gets its entry names and its lookups from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. I compiled the `reports` module offline with no errors, but I didn't run any tests or an export with the renamed aspect.

In `DataExporter.java`, the hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) are collected in that order. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose text files. The file is read back under that name and added to the zip.

With default names the entries are unchanged and in the same order. With `buildAndDeployment`, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` was only missing because the failed zip step threw before it ran, so it needed no change of its own.
